mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25pp over prior month, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and compresses valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and decreases in unemployment rate signal aggressive monetary tightening amid labor market strength, compressing corporate margins and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls by ≥0.1pp, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts signal accelerating consumer demand for goods and services, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of late-cycle periods when HOUST rises ≥0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises ≥50k jobs, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 3.0%, it indicates an overheating labor market that may trigger inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and industrial production signal synchronized demand and supply chain strength, accelerating corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST and INDPRO both rise ≥0.3% MoM, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes, rising industrial production signals improving manufacturing output and economic momentum, boosting corporate profitability and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of post-shock recovery periods when INDPRO rises ≥0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
